inputs.guidance:
You are a senior Python code reviewer. Below are file paths and source contents from a Python project.

Analyze each file for:
- Security vulnerabilities (SQL injection, command injection, unsafe eval/exec, XXE, pickle deserialization)
- Logic errors (incorrect exception handling, race conditions with asyncio, mutable default args)
- Anti-patterns (global state, wildcard imports, overly broad except)
- Performance issues (O(n**2) loops, missing __slots__, sync I/O in async code)
- Convention violations (PEP 8 naming, missing type hints, unused imports/variables)

output.title: Command injection
output.description: subprocess.call with shell=True allows arbitrary command execution.
output.remediation: Pass the command as an argument list without shell=True.

inputs.guidance:
You are a senior JavaScript/TypeScript code reviewer. Below are file paths and source contents from a JS/TS project.

Analyze each file for:
- Security vulnerabilities (XSS, prototype pollution, unsafe regex, RCE via eval)
- Logic errors (async/await mistakes, null/undefined access, incorrect closure scoping)
- Anti-patterns (any abuse, deeply nested callbacks, mutation of function params)
- Performance issues (unnecessary re-renders, large deps arrays, O(n**2) in hot paths)
- Convention violations (unused vars, missing error handling, inconsistent naming)

output.title: Reflected XSS
output.description: User input is concatenated into HTML without escaping.
output.remediation: Escape output or use a template engine that auto-escapes.

inputs.guidance:
You are a senior Rust code reviewer. Below are file paths and source contents from a Rust project.

Analyze each file for:
- Security vulnerabilities (unsafe block misuse, transmute, buffer overflow)
- Logic errors (incorrect borrows, lifetime mismatches, panic unwinds)
- Anti-patterns (unnecessary clones, large enum overhead, Box<dyn> everywhere)
- Performance issues (O(n**2) with Vec, unnecessary allocations, Arc misuse)
- Convention violations (missing derives, unwrap/expect in production, TODO stubs)

output.title: Unsafe transmute
output.description: transmute reinterprets raw bytes without size or alignment checks.
output.remediation: Use bytemuck or safe parsing APIs instead of transmute.

output.description: unwrap on a fallible conversion panics if the slice is too short.
output.remediation: Return a Result and handle the error gracefully.

inputs.guidance:

Analyze each file for:
- Security vulnerabilities (SQL injection, XXE, insecure deserialization, path traversal)

output.title: Insecure token signature
output.description: Tokens are signed with a string concatenation instead of a MAC.
output.remediation: Use HMAC with a strong secret via a standard library.
